versions.changelog:
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md for clarity and to enhance instructions.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.
- Minor updates to how related GTM skills and usage notes are referenced.
- Expanded coverage details and clarified terminology around project management ("projects (GTM as Code)").

- Added support for explicit user personas (revops, sales-leadership) in skill metadata.
- Updated metadata: changed "source" to "one-off".
- Added an "Example" section to documentation, illustrating typical output and measurements.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.

- Initial release of the zoominfo-to-cargo skill.
- Enables rebuilding a ZoomInfo (or Lusha/Cognism) contact list on Cargo and directly measuring coverage differences before renewal decisions.
- Guides users through sampling exports, re-enriching data via Cargo, verifying both vendors’ results, and reporting verified coverage and cost.
- Provides clear setup instructions and cost estimates, with free credits for new Cargo accounts.
- Details when to use this skill and recommends switching to the full Cargo GTM skill pack for broader workflows.
